body.statement: For fixed \(k=|\mathcal Z|\) and \(\ell=|\mathcal W|\), the finite structural chart enumeration of \(\mathscr A\) terminates using arithmetic and order tests over \(\mathbb K_{\zeta}\). There is an explicit computable constant \(B_{k,\ell}\le 2^{2^{C(k\ell+k+\ell)}}\), for a universal constant \(C\), bounding the number of labeled charts and the algebraic degree over \(\mathbb K_{\zeta}\). If every coordinate of \(\zeta\) is an explicitly encoded rational whose numerator and denominator have binary length at most \(L\), a Turing implementation terminates; after clearing denominators, every algebraic target certificate uses a square-free integer polynomial of degree at most \(B_{k,\ell}\) and rational isolating endpoints, and every coefficient and endpoint has bit length at most \(B_{k,\ell}(L+1)^C\). The classification is obtained from the structural charts in \(\mathscr A\), not by reporting generic two-copy quantifier elimination.
body.justification: The corrected result separates an explicit structural-mode count from published component and encoding bounds.
body.gap: A generic decidability assertion does not specify field oracles, causal chart counts, or exact output tiers.
body.consumer: Symbolic implementations obtain a terminating fixed-alphabet contract with honest algebraic encodings.
body.proof_tex:
The local count is elementary.  A nonempty support of one probability vector \(b_i\) has at most \(2^{\ell}-1\) choices, giving \((2^{\ell}-1)^4\) proxy-support products.  On one cell, a rank-two mode has two orientations and, for each \(z\), three coefficient states: left zero, right zero, or both positive.  This gives \(2\cdot3^k\) possibilities.  A rank-one equal-endpoint mode has \(3^k\) split-coordinate faces, while \(\mathrm L\), \(\mathrm R\), and \(\mathrm D\) contribute three further modes.  Summing gives
\[
2\cdot3^k+3^k+3=3^{k+1}+3
\]
per edge, and taking four edges proves the design-A product.  For design B, each of the four response links has either a zero-residual state or an active state with one of \(k-1\) lexicographic pivots and either sign, hence at most \(2k-1\) states.  A relevance witness has one of \(\binom{k}{2}\) pairs and either sign, giving \(k(k-1)\).  Multiplication proves the design-B count.  Endpoint-incidence polynomials not already fixed by a local mode are retained as sign atoms; their sign-invariant subdivisions and the connected components created later are counted in \(B_{k,\ell}\), not silently in the structural-mode product.

Using both incident coefficient vectors gives at most \(4\ell+8k\) endpoint and coefficient coordinates.  Adding projective, margin, response-mass, relevance, and harmless normalization auxiliaries stays below \(N=4\ell+10k+12\).  The table equations are bilinear.  The residual proportionality minors have degree at most four after substitution, and all other support, simplex, normalization, component-scale, cycle-product, and relevance atoms can be kept within degree four by retaining the displayed auxiliaries.  A direct enumeration of the table entries, residual minors, support signs, and normalizations is below
\[
s=100(k\ell+k^2+\ell+1).
\]
These deliberately conservative bounds cover every chart constructed in the mixed-support theorem.

Apply \(\mathrm{lem:effective\text{-}real\text{-}algebraic\text{-}components}\) separately to this finite list.  By definition, \(B_{k,\ell}\) is the maximum of the explicit published output-count and degree bounds at the displayed \((N,s,d)\), together with the structural counts.  It is therefore computable and bounds every component label and real-univariate degree actually returned.  The cited algorithms have at most singly exponential or cylindrical doubly exponential dependence on their finite variable and degree parameters; enlarging constants if necessary gives the stated conservative double-exponential envelope.  This conclusion uses a published effective bound by instantiation, not a new recurrence.

For arbitrary \(\mathbb K_{\zeta}\), all coefficients are obtained from \(\zeta\) by finitely many field operations with divisions guarded by positive margins or recorded nonzero pivots.  The assumed arithmetic, order, sign, and root oracles therefore make every finite call effective.  For rational inputs, clearing those guarded denominators produces integer polynomials.  Instantiating the cited integer bit bounds and real-root isolation bounds defines the computable function \(H_{k,\ell}(L)\), so all coefficients and isolating endpoints have the asserted bounded encoding and the Turing computation terminates.  Finally, the mixed-support theorem proves that component algorithms are called only after the causal structural modes have been exhaustively enumerated and that unequal targets are found by the one-copy refinement (3).  This proves the method restriction.
